{{Quote|May I present His Royal Majesty, Prince Sono Molec, Champion of Listehol, Conqueror of the Slavers' Chain, Uniter of the Guilds, and the one true heir to the Zygerrian Empire.|Captain Rajim Armin|<ref name="FLT" />}}
'''Sono Molec''' was a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[prince]] and the son of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]]. He ruled over the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Empire]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] operations from [[Molec Royal Palace/Legends|his palace]] on the planet [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]].
